review_description: Do you know that feeling of being able to sleep at night because you’ve chosen the right tradie and don’t have to worry about anything? If you don’t then JPM is the business you want to be calling to work on your home. Professional, communicates really well and does a fantastic and well thought out job.

The whole process from quote to installation completion was smooth and professional.  Everything was explained and helpful advice given that gave me confidence.  I also got good advice for an EV charger which was also installed.The installation was done on time and the whole team were friendly, considerate and very tidy.I was so impressed that I recommended JPM Electrical and Solar to my father for his solar installation.

Jarrad and his men were fantastic, exceptional old style customer service- thorough, great communication thorough install and connection information, great sense of humour, not only did they clean up after themselves, they even cleaned my gutters while they were up on roof. Highly recommend and a breeze to work with- awesome local professional business
